security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Correct exams locally with small vision models
bundle.longDescription: Exan compares the answer key with the answers of each participant. Photos are read by a small vision/OCR model running on this PC (Ollama or LM Studio); nothing is uploaded to the internet.
